title: ims-result, version 1, as MOBCAL writes it
description: One calculation of an ion's collision cross section: the program, both inputs, the gas, the temperature, the seed, how the run ended, the cross sections with their units, and a block of what only MOBCAL reports. The file is JSON, NAME.result.json, written into each run directory beside record.json. docs/result-file.md is the specification. The core keys (every top-level key but mobcal) are the format any ion-mobility program can fill; mobcal is this program's extension block. The embedded ion and method documents are checked here by $ref to the schemas of their formats, which the two relative references below resolve to by those schemas' $id; the rules those formats state beyond their schemas are checked by mobcal.io.ion and mobcal.methods when a document is read back, and are not repeated here. Every unit string is fixed per key in version 1.

status.description: How the run ended: ok when the program completed and printed its summary, failed when it did not, stopped when the user ended it.

message.description: Why the run did not end ok, with the exit status; null when it did.

commit.description: The commit the program was built from, with -dirty when the tree held changes no commit holds; null where the program does not know it.

build.description: The executable's entry in the build.json written beside it when it was built (compiler, flags, the SHA-256 of each source and of the executable); null when there is none.

seconds.description: Wall time of the program, in seconds (of every process and the combining run, for a divided run).

seed.description: The seed of the random number generator; mobcal.generator names the generator.

results.description: What the program reports, null when it printed no summary.

time.description: ISO 8601 date and time to the second, with the offset from UTC.

file.description: A file by its name (no folder) and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

area.description: A cross section in square angstroms.

tm_area.description: A trajectory-method cross section, with the standard deviation of its cycles as a percentage of the mean where the program prints one (one coordinate set).

inverse_mobility.description: An inverse reduced mobility 1/K0 in V s m^-2, as the 2012 program prints it: at z = 1 whatever the ion's charge, and at the number density of a gas at 273.15 K and 101325 Pa.

converted_from.description: mfj when the file given was a .mfj, whose ion document is embedded; null for an ion file.

source.description: shipped: a method MOBCAL ships, by its key; file: a method file of one's own; custom: values given beside a method, or in the window, made a method of no file.

name.description: What record.json's method says: a shipped method's key, a method file's name, or custom.

file.description: The method file, for a shipped method or a file; null for custom.

from.description: For custom, the method the values were given beside (a shipped key or a method file's name), null when none was; null otherwise.

overrides.description: For custom, each method-document key whose value differs from the from method's, with the run's value; empty otherwise.

cross_sections.description: The run's cross sections, each the mean over coordinate sets: PA (projection approximation) and EHS (exact hard spheres) in helium, TM (trajectory method) in both gases.

conformers.description: One entry per coordinate set, in the input's order.

trajectories.description: The trajectory method's trajectories: itn x inp x imp in all, and those the program counted as failed.

mobcal.description: What only MOBCAL reports: the extension block of the program the software key names.

split.description: W, the processes the calculation was divided among; null for a serial run.

settings.description: The six run settings, as a method document writes them.

parameters.description: The element table, by its name and the SHA-256 of the file.

staged_input.description: The .mfj the program read, as named in the run directory, and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

files.description: The names, within the run directory, of the program's output, the run's record and the program's console output.

summary.description: Everything else the SUMMARY block of the output prints, typed; null exactly when results is null.

hard_sphere.description: The MOBIL4 pass (helium): its trajectories and the reflections counted; null where it was not run (nitrogen).

minimum_reflections.description: Printed for several coordinate sets only; null for one.

inverse_mobilities.description: The inverse mobility of each method the cross sections name: of the average for one set, and the AVGE row, the inverse of the mean mobility, for several.

asymmetry_parameter.description: The structural asymmetry parameter: of the one set, or the mean of the sets; null where the summary prints none (nitrogen, several sets).

conformers.description: One entry per coordinate set, in the order of results.conformers.

lines.description: The SUMMARY block as printed, from the line SUMMARY to the end of the output, one string per line, end-of-line CR removed.
